title: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient kor planeswalker and lithomancer who retrieves the Lithoform Core, uses it to kill Zareth, and pushes Akiri off a ledge.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger and leader of the adventuring party, who loses Zareth to the Core and is betrayed by Nahiri.

entities.name: Zareth
entities.description: A merfolk scout, Akiri's love, who distrusts Nahiri and dies when she uses the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: A kor cleric of the party who falls in the collapse and is saved by Kaza.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: A human wizard of the party who rescues Orah with her levitating staff.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker who was at Nahiri's side when the Eldrazi were trapped, and whom she fought.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who was at Nahiri's side when the Eldrazi were trapped.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who told Nahiri the Roil began as a reaction to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Lava elemental
entities.description: A giant fiery elemental born from the lava by the Roil, which attacks the party and is destroyed by the Core's blast.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titanic beings imprisoned on Zendikar, whose wrath scarred it.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's upheaval which shakes the Skyclave and which Nahiri believes fights her.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: A small star-like orb that whispers and unleashes a deadly white blast that kills life.

entities.name: Skyclave key
entities.description: The glowing key Nahiri uses to light a path and open the wall of the Core's chamber.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: The stone constructs Nahiri made to trap the Eldrazi, now scattered and tilted.

entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: The ancient floating ruin that Nahiri's party climbs and that tears itself apart when the Core is taken.

entities.name: Sunder Bay
entities.description: The bay below the Skyclave where the climb begins.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The wounded plane Nahiri wants to heal.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: The region where Nahiri earlier tamed the Roil.

events.summary: Nahiri and her party climb stairs she stonecrafts toward the Murasa Skyclave, Nahiri eager to erase the Roil with the Core.
events.quote: With the Lithoform Core, she would erase the Roil and make Zendikar as beautiful and tranquil as it was millennia ago.

events.summary: Nahiri uses the key to light a stone path through the Skyclave, and the party follows it past traps.
events.quote: Then the glowing stones stretched out in a single line deep into the ruins.

events.summary: Nahiri opens a tiled wall with the key by speaking in ancient kor.
In the cavern, a monolith opens to reveal the Lithoform Core, and Nahiri stops Akiri from touching it.
events.quote: "Careful." Nahiri's hand clamped over her wrist in an instant.

events.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and the chamber and Skyclave begin to collapse as the Roil strikes.
events.quote: the surrounding chamber was disintegrating, falling, tearing itself apart

events.summary: Orah and Kaza fall, but Kaza catches them on her staff.
events.quote: Kaza appeared, hovering on her magic staff, with Orah clinging to her waist.

events.summary: Nahiri whispers to Zareth that she knows he wants the Core and uses stone to help them swing across.
events.quote: I know you want the Core for yourself.

events.summary: Nahiri fails to bend a vortex and is thrown off the ruin, but Akiri catches her.
A lava elemental born of the Roil attacks, and Akiri shields Zareth.
events.quote: Akiri was there in front of Zareth

events.summary: Nahiri unleashes the Lithoform Core, wiping out the elemental in a white blast and turning everything ashen gray.
Zareth lies dead, killed by the Core's blast, and Akiri grieves him.
events.quote: Akiri was on her knees, holding the cold, stiff body of the person she loved.

events.summary: Akiri grabs the Core and refuses to give it to Nahiri, but a hedron's dark energy freezes her.
events.quote: The hedron sparked and dark energy reached out from it, coursing through her

events.summary: Nahiri takes the Core and pushes the paralyzed Akiri off the ledge.
events.quote: Akiri could do nothing as Nahiri planted a hand on her shoulder. And pushed.

relations.note: Zareth dies in the blast of the Core that Nahiri unleashes.
relations.quote: Zareth's hand was curled up into a claw, grasping for something.

relations.note: Nahiri pushes her off a ledge to take the Core.
relations.quote: Akiri could do nothing as Nahiri planted a hand on her shoulder. And pushed.

relations.note: Akiri holds the body of the person she loved.
relations.quote: holding the body of her friend, her love, close

relations.note: Nahiri made the hedrons centuries ago.

relations.quote: when she thought trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar was the best course of action

relations.note: Kaza saves Orah in the fall.
relations.quote: Kaza appeared, hovering on her magic staff, with Orah clinging to her waist.
